title: Zalando Delivery Doctor
why: Zalando ships fashion across Europe from several large fulfillment centres, and late parcels turn straight into complaints and returns. This tool breaks every order into its stages, finds what makes parcels late and tests fixes.
problem: An e-commerce company is experiencing increasing delivery delays and customer complaints despite having adequate logistics capacity. Develop an AI system that analyzes orders, warehouses, routes, staffing, inventory and delivery data to identify the root causes and recommend operational improvements.
data_note: 6,000 orders from 4 fulfillment centres over 4 weeks with stage timestamps, staffing, carriers and complaints (sample data).

steps.detail: Orders, warehouses, shifts, staffing, stock location, carriers, delivery scans

steps.step: Root cause by site and shift

steps.detail: Orders shipped from a far warehouse because stock sat elsewhere
Simulate staffing and stock fixes with the model

questions: What is the main reason parcels are late?
